column1: # Every persisted derived body, versioned by its compaction code rather than
# the release. Columns: representation name, version, comma-separated source
# files whose text produces the derived bytes (the owning crate's file
# first), comma-separated Cargo.lock packages whose locked versions the
# derive's bytes depend on (`-` when none), and the sha256 of all of it
# (each file as `path\0bytes\0`, each package as `name\0versions\0`, in
# The version lives at the `Derived::new` or `representation` call site; the
# parity test in the owning crate (derive_parity.rs) checks this table and
# that every `Derived::new("<name>"` in the crate's sources is registered.
# When a transform's source — or one of its listed dependencies' locked
# versions — changes, the test fails naming the new hash: bump the version
# and update this row in the same commit. A row must list every file the
# derive reads bytes through; whole files are hashed, so a formatting or
# comment edit in a listed file also needs the bump (batch cosmetic edits
# in these files). `crates/http/src/derive.rs` is in every transform's set
# because it feeds and parses the body.
